data.title: 埃塔 · 实验台上的午睡
data.description: 实验做到一半，埃塔直接趴在实验台上睡着了，脸旁还摊着写满公式的笔记。同僚们轻手轻脚地绕开——吵醒她的代价，是被拉去试新药。
data.location: laboratory bench with open formula notebooks, beakers and a sleeping researcher
data.action: sleeping face-down on a lab bench in pajamas, arms folded under her head, notebooks scattered around
data.lighting: 实验室午后斜射的柔和光线
data.mood: comic lab peace, dangerous to disturb
data.promptProse: Eta is asleep on the bench again. The whole lab tiptoes — waking her means volunteering for the next trial.
data.animaCaption: Do not wake the scientist. The last volunteer still glows faintly.
